companyDescription: AI connectivity · active electrical cables (AECs), SerDes, optical DSPs for hyperscale AI clusters · FQ1 FY27 revenue $479M (+115%) · FQ2 guide $525–535M, 67–69% non-GAAP GM
priceNote: Live $122.46 (+22.6%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). About 60% below the $302.52 52-week high and ~32% below the 200-day (~$181). It fell 32% in the week to Nov 5 with no company-specific news.
summary: A hypergrowth AI-connectivity name cut by more than half with no company-specific bad news. FQ1 revenue was $479M (+115%), and the FQ2 guide is $525–535M at a 67–69% gross margin. Analysts expect normalized EPS to roughly triple from FY26 to FY28, yet the forward P/E is at a three-year low. FQ2 results are confirmed for Dec 1 after the close (company release), 7 days out and inside the 14d window. Consensus is ~$210–284 (+72%). The risks are concentration (four customers are ~84% of revenue) and the copper-vs-optics debate. Base +20% is a 2–4 week horizon on a beat-and-raise, above the core P75 (10.8%).

catalysts.name: FQ2 FY27 earnings (Dec 1, AMC)
catalysts.description: Confirmed by Credo: results after the close Dec 1, call 2pm PT. Guide $525–535M revenue, 67–69% non-GAAP GM. The read is customer breadth beyond the top two and AEC demand into 2027.

risks: Customer concentration: four end customers were ~84% of FQ1 revenue (one at 33%, another at 28%).
Copper vs optics: investors worry AECs get displaced by optical links; Marvell's Lumentum deal sharpened the debate.
Beat-and-drop pattern: the stock has sold off after strong prints in the 2026 AI-hangover tape.
Extreme beta: -32% in a week, +22.6% in a day; macro WAIT (15/100).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI connectivity semis are among the highest-beta names in the market; profitability helps, but multiples swing with AI-capex sentiment and rates.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Core prior is largely unmeasured in this regime (8/174 windows had SPY down >2%).
